[USER] User is looking for online tutorials on slip-casting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Slip-casting is a ceramic technique with many online resources available.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended websites for slip-casting tutorials:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Ceramics Monthly: Extensive section on slip-casting, articles, videos, tutorials, online courses, and webinars.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Pottery Making Illustrated: Step-by-step guides, videos, and tips from experienced potters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The Ceramic School: Comprehensive guide to slip-casting, beginner's guide, tutorials, and tips on creating molds and casts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. ClayShare: Community-driven platform with tutorials, videos, and articles on various ceramic techniques, including slip-casting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended YouTube channels for slip-casting tutorials:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Simon Leach Pottery: Informative and detailed slip-casting tutorials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Ceramics with Linda: Excellent series on slip-casting, covering mold-making and casting techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Pottery by Osa: Clear, concise tutorials on hand-building and slip-casting techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The Pottery Wheel: Well-produced videos on a range of ceramic tutorials, including slip-casting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended online courses for slip-casting:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Craftsy: Online courses on ceramics, including slip-casting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Udemy: Range of ceramics courses, including slip-casting taught by experienced potters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Skillshare: Online courses and workshops on ceramics, including slip-casting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended books and eBooks on slip-casting:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "The Complete Book of Slip-Casting" by Richard Zakin: Covers basics, mold-making, and advanced techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "Slip-Casting: A Guide to Creating Ceramic Casts" by Linda Arbuckle: Detailed guide covering mold design, casting, and finishing techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reminder to practice safety precautions when working with ceramics and follow proper studio safety guidelines.
